**Stop dropping lone carriage returns in CSV fields on Windows.** On Windows, `buildOutput` sets `writer.UseCRLF` to true. `encoding/csv` then discards a bare `\r` inside a quoted field. A value such as `a\rb` is written as `"ab"`, so parsing the output returns a different value. Either avoid `UseCRLF` when a field contains `\r`, or fall back to a writer that preserves `\r`, and add a test for a lone `\r`.
